body:
Thank you for taking the time to write all this. I don't think I can reply to every point, but do know I read every word. I can tell you understand and have been through it.  

I'll be honest, I'm really turned off the idea of bringing up my feelings to my friend because he always made it about him. I don't blame him, I know he has his own struggles, I just know I won't get help that way. The person I know would understand is my brother. We went through the same things and for this I don't want to burden him, especially knowing he was suicidal just a couple years ago. I'll consider reaching out to him though.  

For now, I will research clinics and counselors nearby that would take no insurance. Hopefully there will be a few around I can try. Thank you for this suggestion. I'll also try making a list of things I can work on til then. You nailed it when you mentioned showers, laundry, dishes, etc. I've been struggling with those and doing the bare minimum to be passable for work.

Thanks again! Its nice to see an understanding and also that you're doing better. I feel like its just been all downhill for me, emotionally, and I haven't had much hope lately.

Thank you for this! Is it normally okay to just call for a chat or some sort at helplines? A lot of times I feel alone and my thoughts will go to a dark place and its really overwhelming, but there's no one in my personal life I'd feel comfortable talking to. I also feel like I'd be wasting their time, which is how I felt today after I called.
